items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Black Pete; the interviewer mentions 'Black Pete's person' and 'Black Pete, you see the piano player?' but the interviewee provides no personal connection or interaction details.

ctx.x: But, uh, pardon me. But your first line up was when I knew you. Behind me was Black Pete's person. Who? Black Pete. Black Pete.
Black Pete, you see the piano player? Yeah.
